legacy-question-index.definition: A legacy card-local string list used to discover cards whose stored question text exactly matches a requested question.
legacy-question-index.disposition: Preserve exact question strings and reverse lookup as discoverability. A matching card is not proof that its body satisfies the question, and the string has no standalone CQ identity or revision.

card-legacy-cq-reference.disposition: Keep the selected root as a distinct observed field. The frozen card census has 30 absent and one empty state; no populated item is available to establish item semantics or equivalence with cq_refs.

card-cq-reference.definition: A concept-card CQ reference collection whose items carry id, path and revision.
card-cq-reference.disposition: Preserve stable identity, location and requested revision as separate reference data. A reference does not prove that the target exists, that an embedded fragment resolves, or that the CQ is answerable.

cq-question-text.disposition: Retain the complete question rather than reducing it to a keyword or card title; a legacy string and a CQ record question are related discovery values, not automatically the same identity.

cq-roles.definition: Separate roles a CQ may play, such as requirement, coverage target, answerability check, verification target or retrieval probe.
cq-roles.disposition: Keep roles distinct and explicit. An empty template list is unassessed configuration, not evidence that the CQ has no role.

cq-requirement-source.definition: The reference to the requirement or source scope that originated the CQ.
cq-requirement-source.disposition: Preserve origin separately from question text and from later coverage/evidence. Null is an unfilled template state; absent in the synthetic example is not a negative provenance finding.

cq-intended-use.definition: The use for which an adequate answer is being assessed.
cq-intended-use.disposition: Keep suitability for exploratory, teaching, retrieval or durable reliance separate from coverage and answerability. The selected standalone records provide null/absent observations only.

cq-answer-criteria.definition: The distinctions, conditions, support and review requirements an adequate answer must contain.
cq-answer-criteria.disposition: Preserve explicit criteria as a requirement boundary; its null/absent frozen states do not mean that a question is answerable or that any generated body meets it.

cq-components.definition: The root collection of exact constructs mapped to the CQ's required answer components.
cq-components.disposition: Retain the collection as a coverage-map input, not as the required answer component, an answer, or a source-support result. Component availability and warrant remain separate.

cq-component-item.definition: One exact concept, claim or source-support construct reference mapped to a required answer component.
cq-component-item.disposition: Preserve each mapped construct and its role; the synthetic example has three items, while the template has no component_refs root. Do not treat this list as equivalent to coverage_assertions.

cq-component-id.definition: The stable identity requested for one CQ component.
cq-component-id.disposition: Use identity to target a concept, claim or support construct, but do not infer path resolution, source warrant or verification from id presence.

cq-component-revision.definition: The requested revision of one component reference.
cq-component-revision.disposition: Keep requested revision visible and scoped to the component. It does not inherit a CQ revision or prove that the requested revision is available.

cq-component-role.definition: The role assigned to one component reference, such as concept, claim or source-support.
cq-component-role.disposition: Use role to distinguish what the component supplies; a source-support role is not itself a source-support result or evidence-grade decision.

cq-coverage-assertions.definition: The root collection of identifiable assertions, one per required answer component, that explain what mapped constructs supply.
cq-coverage-assertions.disposition: The guide first identifies required answer components, then maps each to exact constructs and a coverage assertion. The template exposes one null/unassessed slot and the synthetic populated CQ lacks this root, so no populated encoding or equivalence with component_refs is inferred.

cq-coverage-assertion-item.definition: One identifiable coverage assertion linking a required answer component to mapped constructs and its scoped rationale.
cq-coverage-assertion-item.disposition: Preserve the assertion boundary for later scoped support and result references; an empty covered_refs list is not a completed absence finding.

cq-coverage-assertion-assertion.definition: The assertion's rationale explaining how mapped constructs supply the required answer component.
cq-coverage-assertion-assertion.disposition: Keep this rationale separate from the required component, its covered_refs constructs, and answer text. Null in the template is unassessed, not an empty semantic assertion.

cq-coverage-assertion-component.definition: The required answer component addressed by one coverage assertion, distinct from the constructs mapped to it.
cq-coverage-assertion-component.disposition: Treat this as the required-part slot, not a component_refs item or covered_refs target. The template value is null and does not demonstrate a populated encoding; no equivalence to the synthetic component_refs list is inferred.

cq-coverage-assertion-state.definition: The state of one coverage assertion.
cq-coverage-assertion-state.disposition: Keep assertion-level state distinct from root coverage_state and answerability_state; the template's unassessed value does not describe the synthetic partial example.

cq-coverage-assertion-covered-refs.definition: References to constructs covered by one assertion.
cq-coverage-assertion-covered-refs.disposition: Preserve empty versus populated references and their target scope; no source support or answer warrant is invented when the collection is empty.

cq-coverage-assertion-id.definition: The stable identity of one embedded coverage assertion.
cq-coverage-assertion-id.disposition: Keep assertion identity separate from parent CQ identity so later results can target the assertion; null is the template's unassigned state.

cq-coverage-assertion-revision.definition: The revision of one embedded coverage assertion.
cq-coverage-assertion-revision.disposition: Preserve assertion revision applicability independently of component and parent-CQ revisions; no revision is available in the template witness.

cq-coverage-assertion-support-refs.definition: Source-support references attached to one coverage assertion.
cq-coverage-assertion-support-refs.disposition: Keep support scoped to the assertion. The empty template collection does not establish unsupportedness or require a synthetic support record.

cq-coverage-state.definition: A root summary of how much of the question's required coverage is present.
cq-coverage-state.disposition: Treat partial coverage as a bounded summary, not as answerability, verification or admission. The template lacks this selected root while its assertion slot is unassessed.

cq-answerability.definition: A scoped judgment of whether mapped material can answer the question under its criteria and intended use.
cq-answerability.disposition: Keep full/partial/not-yet answerability separate from reference resolution, coverage and retrieval. The synthetic example is partially answerable because the locator is fictional/unassessed; the template is unassessed.

cq-status.disposition: Use status only for question lifecycle. Draft does not mean uncovered, and active would not prove answerability or evidence.

memberships.effective_meaning: Required distinctions, conditions, support and review checks for an adequate answer; selected records show template null and synthetic absent.
memberships.disposition: Preserve requirement boundary; do not infer answer quality from its absence.

memberships.effective_meaning: Scoped answerability judgment, separate from coverage and retrieval; template is unassessed and synthetic is partially-answerable.
memberships.disposition: Keep bounded answerability and unknown state; no full answer is manufactured.

memberships.effective_meaning: Legacy card-local array of natural-language questions used for exact reverse lookup.
memberships.disposition: Retain discoverability and readable question text without assigning standalone CQ identity.

memberships.effective_meaning: One legacy question string; no id, revision, role or answer criterion is carried by the item.
memberships.disposition: Preserve exact strings and target-card lookup limits.

memberships.effective_meaning: Legacy-named card-level CQ reference collection; 30 absent and one empty across the frozen 31-card population.
memberships.disposition: Retain observed absent/empty distinction; no item semantics or equivalence is accepted.

memberships.effective_meaning: Root collection of exact constructs mapped to the CQ's required answer components; populated only in the synthetic CQ among the two standalone records.
memberships.disposition: Keep as a coverage-map input, not the required answer component, evidence, or an answer.

memberships.effective_meaning: One exact concept, claim or source-support construct mapped to a required answer component; the synthetic witness has three.
memberships.disposition: Preserve mapped-construct boundaries and unresolved target limits; do not equate this list with coverage_assertions.

memberships.effective_meaning: Requested component identity for a concept, claim or source-support target.
memberships.disposition: Do not equate id occurrence with path resolution or warrant.

memberships.effective_meaning: Requested component revision, observed as 1 on all three synthetic component items.
memberships.disposition: Keep revision scope explicit; no inheritance or availability is inferred.

memberships.effective_meaning: Role of a component in the answer map: concept, claim or source-support.
memberships.disposition: Preserve role-specific consequences; source-support role is not a support result.

memberships.effective_meaning: Root collection of identifiable assertions, one per required answer component, that explain what mapped constructs supply; template has one slot and synthetic standalone CQ lacks the root.
memberships.disposition: The guide's sequence distinguishes required answer components, mapped constructs and assertions. Do not equate the template slot with populated CQ coverage or the synthetic component_refs list.

memberships.effective_meaning: One identifiable coverage assertion linking a required answer component to mapped constructs and scoped rationale; the template supplies one unassessed item.
memberships.disposition: Keep assertion scope available for later result references.

memberships.effective_meaning: The assertion's rationale explaining how mapped constructs supply the required answer component; template value is null.
memberships.disposition: Keep this rationale separate from the required component, covered_refs constructs, question text and answer text.

memberships.effective_meaning: The required answer component addressed by one assertion, distinct from the constructs mapped to it; template value is null.
memberships.disposition: Keep the required-part slot separate from component_refs and covered_refs. Null does not demonstrate its populated encoding.

memberships.effective_meaning: Assertion-level coverage state; template value is unassessed.
memberships.disposition: Do not promote it to root coverage or answerability.

memberships.effective_meaning: Construct references covered by one assertion; template collection is empty.
memberships.disposition: Preserve empty as no refs recorded, not as proof of no coverage.

memberships.effective_meaning: Embedded coverage assertion identity; template value is null.
memberships.disposition: Keep distinct from parent CQ identity.

memberships.effective_meaning: Embedded coverage assertion revision; template value is null.
memberships.disposition: No revision applicability is inferred from the parent record.

memberships.effective_meaning: Support references scoped to the coverage assertion; template collection is empty.
memberships.disposition: Do not invent support records or treat component identity as support.

memberships.effective_meaning: Root coverage summary; synthetic example is partial and template lacks the root.
memberships.disposition: Keep summary distinct from answerability, evidence and verification.

memberships.effective_meaning: Current card CQ reference collection; 18 item references occur across rich, teaching and synthetic families, while pilot/template states are empty or absent.
memberships.disposition: Preserve family-specific absent/empty/populated states and reference limits.

memberships.effective_meaning: One card CQ reference tuple with id, path and revision; all 18 observed items use revision 1.
memberships.disposition: Treat tuple as a declaration, not proof of target or answerability.

memberships.effective_meaning: Stable CQ identity requested by a card reference.
memberships.disposition: Keep identity separate from fragment and rendered-anchor resolution.

memberships.effective_meaning: Declared target location or embedded fragment for a card CQ reference.
memberships.disposition: Record path availability and literal heading separately; a fragment is not automatically a rendered anchor.

memberships.effective_meaning: Requested CQ revision; all 18 frozen items request revision 1.
memberships.disposition: Do not infer embedded revision inheritance or target availability.

memberships.effective_meaning: Standalone question lifecycle status; template is draft and synthetic example omits the field.
memberships.disposition: Keep draft/active status separate from coverage and answerability.

memberships.effective_meaning: Intended answer use; template is null and synthetic example omits the field.
memberships.disposition: Do not silently change the use to make a partial answer acceptable.

memberships.effective_meaning: Standalone CQ natural-language question; template is null and synthetic example has one populated string.
memberships.disposition: Retain full text and avoid conflating it with a legacy answer string or heading anchor.

memberships.effective_meaning: Originating requirement/source reference; template is null and synthetic example omits it.
memberships.disposition: Leave origin unassessed rather than infer it from the question body.

memberships.effective_meaning: Explicit CQ role list; template is empty and synthetic example omits it.
memberships.disposition: Keep role semantics separate from component roles and lifecycle actors.
